emotions.label: Anxious
emotions.description: Uneasy about something that might happen.

emotions.label: Worried
emotions.description: Returning again and again to a possible problem.

emotions.label: Frustrated
emotions.description: Held back from something you wanted or expected.

emotions.label: Tense
emotions.description: Holding tightness in your body or mind.

emotions.label: Irritated
emotions.description: Easily bothered, even by small things.

emotions.label: Annoyed
emotions.description: Mildly bothered by something or someone.

emotions.label: Stressed
emotions.description: Stretched by more demands than feel manageable.

emotions.label: Panicked
emotions.description: Swept up by sudden, intense alarm.

emotions.label: Angry
emotions.description: Strongly displeased, often about something that feels unfair.

emotions.label: Joyful
emotions.description: Full of bright, lively happiness.

emotions.label: Excited
emotions.description: Eager about something ahead.

emotions.label: Curious
emotions.description: Interested in exploring or learning more.

emotions.label: Motivated
emotions.description: Ready and willing to take action.

emotions.label: Proud
emotions.description: Pleased with something you did or who you are.

emotions.label: Energised
emotions.description: Lively, with energy to spare.

emotions.label: Inspired
emotions.description: Moved by an idea or example to create or act.

emotions.label: Confident
emotions.description: Trusting your ability to handle what comes.

emotions.label: Hopeful
emotions.description: Expecting that something good could happen.

emotions.label: Sad
emotions.description: Carrying a sense of loss or heaviness.

emotions.label: Melancholy
emotions.description: A quiet, lingering sadness, sometimes reflective.

emotions.label: Down
emotions.description: Low in spirits.

emotions.label: Tired
emotions.description: Needing rest or sleep.

emotions.label: Exhausted
emotions.description: Drained, with little energy left.

emotions.label: Discouraged
emotions.description: Losing confidence or enthusiasm after setbacks.

emotions.label: Lonely
emotions.description: Wanting more connection with others.

emotions.label: Gloomy
emotions.description: Seeing things in a dim, heavy light.

emotions.label: Unmotivated
emotions.description: Finding it hard to start or to care about tasks.

emotions.label: Calm
emotions.description: Settled and steady.

emotions.label: Relaxed
emotions.description: Free from tension and at rest.

emotions.label: Serene
emotions.description: Deeply peaceful and clear.

emotions.label: Peaceful
emotions.description: Quiet and undisturbed inside.

emotions.label: Grateful
emotions.description: Thankful for something or someone.

emotions.label: Content
emotions.description: Satisfied with how things are right now.

emotions.label: Comforted
emotions.description: Soothed by support, care or familiar things.

emotions.label: Tranquil
emotions.description: Still and unhurried.

emotions.label: At Ease
emotions.description: Comfortable, without worry.
